svg.title: JGDMS SCAP five-host pipeline
svg.desc: Detailed diagram of the five-host Safe Codebase Audit Pipeline showing host roles, trust levels, permitted connections, forbidden paths, data objects, and SPIFFE identities.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Host 1 the Jini Lookup Service role in SCAP')
sendPrompt('Explain Host 4 the Codebase Downloader role in SCAP')
sendPrompt('Explain Host 5 the JFR Telemetry Service role in SCAP')
sendPrompt('Explain Host 2 the Bytecode Analysis Engine pool in SCAP')
g.text: Inbound JERI: Host 4 and Host 5 only
Each instance: own key pair for JarAnalysisReport

svg.text: ⚠ No direct path: Host 2 → Host 3 (key isolation invariant)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Host 3 the Verdict Registry role in SCAP')
g.text: Trust: HIGH · holds client signing key
No bytecode parsing · no URL fetching
Quorum: K of N engines must return SAFE
Any DANGEROUS or CrashReport → immediate deny

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do client nodes interact with the SCAP pipeline?')
g.text: absent or DANGEROUS → refuse · log · alert
